stage: character and key-pose study, not animation frames
anchorGeneration:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a canonical character anchor for a premium desktop AI task companion.
Design ONE completely new original little dog mascot for KodaX Space, an elegant warm-graphite / warm-paper desktop agent workbench with restrained forest-green and amber accents. This is the source character for a coherent future set of task-state animations. The intended on-screen size is only 32 to 40 pixels tall; readable silhouette and expressive posture matter more than tiny details.

Subject: a small warm-apricot, cream-muzzled floppy-eared companion dog. Compact rounded body, short sturdy paws, a moderately oversized rounded head (about 40% of full height, not a giant bobblehead), visible neck, soft broad muzzle, dark espresso oval eyes and nose, simple clear brows. The ears are short soft hanging ears that can perk at their bases; the tail is a simple gently curved tapered shape suitable for a small wag. Cream muzzle and small cream chest, medium caramel ears; thin muted forest-green collar with ONE small plain brass circular tag, no engraving. No other accessories. Friendly, quietly capable, a little curious; not a baby toy and not a robot.
Style: extremely polished clean 2D character illustration with softly modeled flat color volumes; warm dark-brown outer contour of consistent weight and few strong shapes. Subtle restrained shading, no fur strands, no photoreal texture, no glossy plastic, no 3D clay render, no pixel art, no UI icon abstraction. It should feel like a memorable professionally art-directed animation character in a sophisticated productivity tool.
Pose: full body, sitting relaxed with both front paws grounded and separated, head turned slightly toward the viewer, in a THREE-QUARTER view facing screen-right. A calm gentle closed-mouth expression. Tail visibly separated from torso. Anatomically believable dog limbs, four legs with natural occlusion, no hands. Keep all features clear rather than decorative. This one exact silhouette, face, collar, fur markings and proportions must be reproducible across later actions.
Composition: single dog alone, centered at a consistent natural upright baseline, entire ears, paws and tail visible with generous transparent padding. Output ideally 1024 x 1024 pixels. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no props, no border, no vignette, no background color, no floor, no fake checkerboard, no cast shadow or glow. Use genuine transparent alpha outside the dog, with clean edges suitable for both dark and light backgrounds.
anchorRefinement:
Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit.
Refine this new KodaX companion dog character anchor into a more restrained, legible small desktop mascot. The supplied image is the EDIT TARGET, not an unrelated reference.

Keep: the same warm apricot floppy-eared little dog, the same cream forehead blaze, cream muzzle/chest/paws, caramel ears, muted green collar and plain brass round tag. Keep the sitting full-body three-quarter view toward screen-right, friendly curiosity, and genuine transparent background. Keep the recognizably same dog and facial identity.

Change ONLY the rendering simplification and slight maturity: remove ALL interior fur tufts and hair strokes, remove triangular fur highlights and many layered shadows; use large smooth coherent flat-color forms with only one soft shadow region per major form. Reduce the size of the large glossy eyes by about 25 percent and make their highlights very small, avoiding a baby-toy expression. Shorten the dangling ear length slightly so the face is not swallowed by the ears at small sizes. Make the outer contour cleaner, slightly thicker, consistently dark espresso. Keep the mouth as one simple gentle line. Keep paws clearly separated. Make the tail one simple clean curved shape with a cream tip, no fur subdivisions.
Art direction: sophisticated clean 2D animation model-sheet art for a calm professional desktop tool, not a children's book illustration, not a 3D render, not clip-art gradients. Favor an immediately readable silhouette when scaled to 32–40 px tall. Do not add any clothing, props, text, symbols, background, border or shadow. One isolated character with ample transparent padding, ideally 1024 x 1024.
keyPoses:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: task-companion dog ACTION MODEL SHEET, NOT a finished animation.
The supplied image is the canonical new KodaX dog character. Expand this character into NINE distinct full-body KEY POSES, showing this SAME EXACT dog in a regular 3 columns by 3 rows grid on genuine transparent alpha. This is ONE coherent character set, not nine different dog designs.

Identity invariants: warm-apricot coat, cream forehead blaze, broad cream muzzle and chest, cream paws and cream tail-tip, caramel short floppy ears, moderately large rounded head, dark espresso eyes/nose/clean outline, muted green narrow collar and ONE plain brass circular tag. EXACT same facial construction, skull shape, body proportions, coloring and simple clean 2D shaded-flat animation illustration throughout. Don't add fur texture. No hats, glasses, computers, papers, tools, clothes, speech bubbles, icons or effects.
Camera and composition: same three-quarter view toward screen-right, nearly frontal face; camera elevation, drawing scale and light source held constant. Every dog fits entirely within its own equal-sized square cell, centered horizontally, feet or resting body aligned to the same ground baseline within that cell. Plenty of transparent separation, no touching neighbors, no cropping of tail or ears. Ideally 1536 x 1536 canvas with nine 512 x 512 cells and about 55 px clear padding per cell. Do not draw grid lines or numbers or labels; only the nine dogs with transparent surrounding area. No background, floor plane, shadows, border, watermark, fake checkerboard or text.

Row 1, left to right:
1. IDLE / available: original relaxed seated pose, front paws grounded, tail curved, eyes open gentle closed-mouth smile.
2. ACKNOWLEDGE user: seated, head lifted toward viewer with a curious small head tilt, one ear base slightly raised, friendly attentive look. All paws grounded, tail slightly perked.
3. THINKING: seated, head lowered just a little and tilted to one side, gaze directed slightly upward, brows gently engaged, mouth closed; quiet concentration, no human hand-on-chin gesture.

Row 2, left to right:
4. WORKING: on all four paws with compact body gently leaning forward, head lowered a little toward imaginary work just ahead, eyes intent, tail level. Clearly different from a seated thinking pose. Four natural canine legs, no human anatomy.
5. WAITING FOR USER / decision: sitting upright, ONE FRONT PAW lifted just a little off the ground, looking toward the right where status text would sit, calm expectant face. The lifted paw remains a canine paw, never a human waving hand.
6. NEEDS CHECKING / problem: seated, head angled downward and looking back toward viewer, one brow slightly raised and ears relaxed; gentle concern without crying, panic, tears or shame. Closed mouth.

Row 3, left to right:
7. MILESTONE COMPLETE: sitting tall, eyes happy and mouth slightly open in a small restrained canine smile, head and ears perked, tail raised; no jumping, no confetti, no exaggerated expression.
8. SHORT WALK: natural four-paw mid-step profile-three-quarter pose with one front paw forward and opposite back paw advancing, head calm, no running or flying.
9. REST / no task: curled or lying comfortably on belly with head resting on front paws, eyes peacefully closed; same unmistakable ear colors, blaze and green collar visible.

Ensure nine clean, usable, highly consistent character key poses that remain distinguishable at 40 pixels tall through BODY posture as well as facial expression. This sheet is for evaluating the new character's expressive range, not a claim of interpolated or looping animation frames.
